scientific_integrity: All mathematical claims have self-contained finite first-step and moment proofs. Named comparisons are limited to inspected material; independent historical priority and external validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Equal independent rates for undirected length-two path adsorption on finite complete bipartite substrates; perfect-cover probability. The Gaussian limit is for the normalized across-composition profile, not an individual-graph local limit. General graph geometries and unequal rates are not covered.
title: Balanced substrates optimize exact trimer adsorption: a Pólya-urn profile and a Gaussian design window
